plants.credit_line: Cancer bush (Lessertia frutescens; syn. Sutherlandia frutescens), flowers and developing pods, Pretoria National Botanical Garden. Photo: SAplants, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
plants.why: Clear species photograph under the current name Lessertia frutescens, showing diagnostic scarlet flowers and inflated pods.
plants.notes: Curtis Botanical Magazine plate File:Lessertia frutescens.jpg is Public domain but only 561×999 px on Commons; unsuitable for print, so the SAplants field photo was preferred.

plants.artist: N. J. Jacquin (plate); scan by Oceancetaceen - Alice Chodura
plants.credit_line: Artemisia afra Jacq. Upper part of the plant. Plate (Tafel 467) from N. J. Jacquin, Plantarum rariorum Horti caesarei Schoenbrunnensis, vol. 4 (Vienna: C. F. Wappler, 1804). Scan: Oceancetaceen (Alice Chodura), Wikimedia Commons (public domain).
plants.why: Historic Schoenbrunn plate correctly identified as Artemisia afra, print-ready resolution, showing characteristic dissected foliage.
